reviews.t: Buy it but use with caution
reviews.x: This thing is amazing! Like a cheese grater but SHARP so use only on rough patches and carefully around soft skin. Instantly fixed my cracked heels better than any pedicure callous treatment removal. Again, just be careful and go easy. Don't over do it!
I can't use this.  It ripped the skin on my feet.  As sharp as a cheese grater!
Works well except for capturing debris.. be careful using it because you can take off too much.  I must take the blame for that. Operator error.  It woks for sure
The item arrived used with someone else's skin cells on it and the packaging. Clear tape used to reseal.

I used this as soon as it arrived because the dry, cracked heels were and uncomfortable issue.  This works amazingly well and with little effort.  In fact, it's so sharp that you don't want to apply pressure.  A gentle glide is enough to remove layers of dead skin leaving your feet like almost brand new. I would say it good to have in between your pampering and be very very careful 😊

reviews.t: Heavy duty and works better than others
reviews.x: I wasn't sure about ordering this because the low price made me think it might be kind of cheaply made and not hold up well.  I am now so glad I bought it.  It works so much better than other file style callus removers I have tried.  Easier to use and much more effective than the Ped Egg - which I have been using for many years.  This is much more heavy duty and faster than the Ped Egg.  Just one thing - when you use it, put a cloth or paper down to catch the filings.  There were more than I tho

This foot file is fabulous, but it will tear chunks out of you if you're too aggressive with it (like me)! It is large, light, and says it's made of stainless steel. It's just like the ones used during professional pedicures. The first time I used it, I was in a bit of a hurry and tore chunks out of my big toe and heel before I even realized it. This sucker is super sharp and seems it will last a long time. I'll chalk my bloody experience up to operator error. And it was very bloody! 😂

I purchased this foot scrubber and really didn't expect much from it. Oh my was I ever wrong. This one is just like the one in the nail salon. It is easy to use and easily scraped off my thick and scaley dry skin. I didn't have to use much pressure and it did the job perfectly. I love it so much that I'm going to order an extra one. Also forgot to mentiion that he handle makes it very easy to hold and it is very comfortable for the hand.

I was using the pumice scrubber from Sally's but noticed it wasn't doing a good job, my feel were still rough so a friend recommended this scrubber. I used it in the shower after my feet soaked a bit in warm water. I saw how easy it scraped off my dead skin and I got a little too excited and kept going a little harder, almost cut myself and the heal was raw for the next few days lol so be very careful and gentle when using this!

This seemed wonderfully effective as it quickly filed down my worst calluses...until my toes started *bleeding*! It's basically a very sharp cheese grater being sold as a foot file--and so sharp that it makes clean "slices" that took a moment to start bleeding. I will never risk my poor feet again, and now it's hard for me to use my actual cheese grater without getting grossed out thinking about my bleeding feet! :0

Best file I’ve ever purchased and the price can’t be beat. Be sure to apply soap/body wash prior to use. When scraping be gentle. I suggest touching the area your filing.  Depending on the thickness of your callus you might not get it as smooth as you would like the first time. Stick with it a few times per week. Moisturize your feet afterwards.

I love this thing! I've had callouses for decades that I thought were with me until death, until my daughter purchased me a pedicure. The attendant used something similar to this, inspiring me to buy one. Several reviews said it cut too deeply. That all depends on the user. A gentle touch is sufficient.

claims.text: Reviewers widely say the product works effectively, often better than pumice stones or pedicures, for removing dead skin and smoothing rough, cracked heels.
Many reviewers praise the quality and value for money, noting it feels durable and better made than expected for the price.
A common warning is that the tool is very sharp and can remove too much skin or cause abrasions if used carelessly.
At least one reviewer reports the tool ripped the skin on their feet, calling it as sharp as a cheese grater.
One reviewer received an item that arrived used, with residue and resealed packaging.
